description: This source file defines an abstract base class for activation rebalancing tests in an Orleans-based testing environment, including related interfaces and classes for test grains.

classes.name: RebalancingTestBase`1
classes.description: An abstract base class for activation rebalancing tests, providing setup and utility methods for managing silos and grain activations.

classes.name: IRebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: An interface defining a test grain with a Ping method used in activation rebalancing tests.

classes.name: RebalancingTestGrain
classes.description: A basic implementation of IRebalancingTestGrain that completes the Ping task immediately.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Counts how many activations of a specific silo are present based on grain stats.

methods.name: AddTestActivations
methods.description: Adds a specified number of test grain activation tasks targeted at a specific silo.

methods.name: CalculateVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of an array of integer values.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by forcing activation collection on the management grain.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method meant to be called on the test grain to verify responsiveness.
